items.title: Manuel Paul Interview, 1960-04-19
items.q: I don't know if it's Joe Harris or something Harris. He played trombone.

ctx.x: Think of those fellas name, I just can't call them all. I used to call all of those fellas name. All those trombones. Now, this is Harris. Trombone player? I don't know if it's Joe Harris or something Harris. He played trombone.
